scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: node scripts/check-source-rules.mjs && npm run test -w packages/core && npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test:e2e
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.start:split: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run start -w apps/api" "npm run preview -w apps/web"
